'''Benji Dalfor''' is one of [[Gawyn Trakand]]'s [[Younglings]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has only just gained his first whiskers. He has a scar on his cheek.{{ref/book|6|p}}

== Activities ==
He fought in the [[White Tower Schism]].{{ref/book|6|p}} He is with Gawyn when they are sent to act as escort for a group of [[Aes Sedai]] that make an alliance with the [[Shaido]]. He is wounded and then dies after giving his report to Gawyn.{{ref/book|6|55}}
